history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with dark, tousled hair is posing on a vintage orange and black Harley-Davidson motorcycle. He's wearing a light grey t-shirt with a small logo on the chest and light-wash denim jeans. The man is leaning back slightly, with his hands tucked into the front of his jeans, looking off to the right with a relaxed yet cool expression. The motorcycle has a prominent chrome engine and handlebars, and the "Harley-Davidson" logo is clearly visible on the fuel tank.

Behind the man and the motorcycle is a bright yellow wall with bold black Korean text and the English phrase "NO PARK" in large letters. Below "NO PARK," there's more Korean text, partially obscured by the motorcycle. The overall lighting is bright, suggesting an indoor or shaded outdoor environment, casting soft shadows. The color palette is dominated by the vibrant yellow of the background, the orange and black of the motorcycle, and the muted tones of the man's clothing. The mood is stylish and urban, with a touch of retro cool. The image has a slightly desaturated, cinematic quality.
